sections.heading: Licensing and graduated permits
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Licensing and graduated permits

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A12
A passenger-car learner-permit holder needs a licensed driver aged at least 21 in the adjacent seat. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A12
The learner-permit written test is waived after issuance of a school learner, school or learner permit that is valid or expired no longer than a year. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A12
The learner permit expires a year after it is issued. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A12
A provisional-permit holder may drive without supervision from 6 a.m. until midnight. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A12
Unsupervised provisional driving between midnight and 6 a.m. is limited to trips between home and work or a school activity. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A12
A provisional driver may drive at any time with an accompanying parent, guardian or licensed driver who is at least 21. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A12
A provisional permit cannot be issued before the sixteenth birthday, although application may start 60 days earlier. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A12
Before a provisional-permit application, a school learner, school or learner permit must have been held for at least 6 months. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A12
A provisional applicant must have fewer than 3 points accumulated during the 6 months immediately before applying. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A12
The provisional-permit practice route requires certification of fifty driving hours, including ten between sunset and sunrise, signed by a parent, guardian or licensed driver aged at least twenty-one. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A12
A DMV-approved Nebraska driver-safety course waives the provisional written and drive tests. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A12
A provisional applicant using practice certification needs vision and drive tests, with the written test waived for a learner permit valid or expired no longer than a year. [A12]
Source: [A12 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-R13 | anchor: A13
Every person riding with a provisional-permit driver must use an occupant-protection system. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R14 | anchor: A13
A provisional permit expires on the holder’s eighteenth birthday. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R15 | anchor: A13
A Class O license authorizes noncommercial motor vehicles, including mopeds, autocycles, all-terrain vehicles and utility-terrain vehicles, but excludes motorcycles and commercial motor vehicles. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R16 | anchor: A13
An autocycle cannot be used for the Class O drive test. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R17 | anchor: A13
The minimum age for an operator license is 17. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R18 | anchor: A13
An applicant below age 18 qualifies for an operator license after holding a provisional permit for at least 12 months with fewer than 3 points during the previous 12 months. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R19 | anchor: A13
An operator applicant younger than eighteen receives written- and drive-test waivers after holding a provisional permit for at least twelve months and accumulating fewer than three points during the previous twelve months. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R20 | anchor: A13
A provisional-permit holder applying for an operator license between ages eighteen and twenty-one receives a waiver of the written and drive tests. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R21 | anchor: A13
A first-time operator applicant aged eighteen or older who never held a provisional permit needs vision, written and drive tests, with the written test waived for a learner permit that is valid or expired no more than a year. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R22 | anchor: A13
For a first-time operator applicant aged at least 18, a learner permit valid or expired no longer than a year waives the written test. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R23 | anchor: A13
Applicants below age 18 who surrender a valid out-of-state permit or license must meet provisional-permit requirements. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R24 | anchor: A13
A new resident aged at least 18 who surrenders a valid out-of-state license needs a vision test, with drive testing left to licensing staff discretion. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-R25 | anchor: A13
A new Nebraska resident aged eighteen or older must take the written test if unable to surrender the out-of-state license or if that license has expired. [A13]
Source: [A13 -> pdf-0013]
